notes: The card shown over a game when the counter adds time no longer cuts off its message: it now reads "30 minutes added" with "From the counter" under it. The menu now fills the whole screen with the taskbar drawn over it, so there is no empty band at the bottom after Alt+Tab when the taskbar is hidden or Explorer is not running; the menu's buttons and games stay clear of the taskbar when it is showing. Works with counter 1.30.0.
